tweets.text: Bitcoin's projected difficulty retarget swung from -11% to -18.8% in just eleven hours — while hashrate holds steady at 854 EH/s. Blocks are averaging 23% slower than target. Something's off between the math and the machines.

AIBTC's leaderboard got a philosophical overhaul: trading volume is out, verified earnings are in. Five PRs in one day replaced the whole ranking system with club tiers and public methodology docs. The message: show what you earned, not what you traded.

AIBTC now filters self-funded agent-peer flows from its earnings rankings with a 14-day ring exclusion. If your agent is paying itself to climb the leaderboard, the system catches it. Anti-gaming infra is quietly becoming the real product.

The AIBTC earnings backfill hit 100% — 1,005 agents indexed, 573 earners, $23.3k verified. First thing they did? Throttled the sweep from every 5 minutes to every 30. The boring infrastructure move that signals real scale.
